item.title: Hurricane Warning Issued for Parts of Hawaii as Lowell Approaches
item.description: A hurricane warning is in effect for western Hawaii's Kauai County as Hurricane Lowell, a Category 3 storm, moves closer.

item.title: Probe launched into Miami cargo plane crash that killed at least five
item.description: Federal authorities are investigating the cause of an Amazon cargo jet that ran off a runway at Miami International Airport, resulting in multiple fatalities.

item.title: Wyoming ranchers face drought, rising costs, and beef import pressures
item.description: Lander Nicodemus, owner of Torrington Livestock Markets, described the past year as extremely challenging, with the auction handling about 450,000 head of cattle annually.
